model_annotation: The plot illustrates the Loss versus Iteration for several models. The x-axis is labeled "#Iteration" and is a linear scale ranging from 0 to 150000, with tick labels at increments of 20000. The y-axis is labeled "Loss" and is a linear scale ranging from 2.4 to 3.4. A purple solid line, labeled "Vanilla", starts at a Loss value of 3.39 at iteration 0 and decreases to a Loss value of 2.44 at iteration 150000. A grey solid line, labeled "StrmLLM (n=64, H/T)", begins at a Loss value of 3.30 at iteration 0 and decreases to a Loss value of 2.44 at iteration 150000. An orange solid line, labeled "SepLLM (n=64, H)", starts at 3.30 Loss at iteration 0 and decreases to a Loss value of 2.43 at iteration 150000. A green solid line, labeled "SepLLM (n=64, H/T)", commences at a Loss of 3.30 at iteration 0 and declines to a Loss value of 2.42 at iteration 150000. A blue solid line, labeled "SepLLM (n=128)", begins at a Loss of 3.30 at iteration 0 and decreases to a Loss value of 2.41 at iteration 150000.
